name: The Friendship of Christ
desc: Benson's best-known devotional book (1912), thirteen discourses on friendship with Christ: in the interior soul (the purgative and illuminative ways), in the Eucharist, the Church, the priest, the saint, the sinner, the average man and the sufferer, and in His Passion and Resurrection.
desc_pt: O livro devocional mais conhecido de Benson (1912), treze discursos sobre a amizade com Cristo: na alma interior (as vias purgativa e iluminativa), na Eucaristia, na Igreja, no sacerdote, no santo, no pecador, no homem comum e no que sofre, e em Sua Paixão e Ressurreição.
edition: The Friendship of Christ (London: Hutchinson, 1912), Internet Archive full-text OCR (friendshipofchri00bens).
manual: Part I: Christ in the Interior Soul
I. The Friendship of Christ: General
II. The Friendship of Christ: Interior
Part II: Christ in the Exterior
X. Christ in the Average Man
Part III: Christ in His Historical Life
XII. Christ Our Friend Crucified: The Seven Words
XIII. Christ Our Friend Vindicated: Easter Day
